drop_sub: Subfolders are included. Nothing changes until you press Run
opt_use_mtime: Use modified time when no date
summary: Move {move} · Convert {convert} · No date {nodate} · Duplicates {dupes} · Unchanged {same}
dlg_date_prompt:
Date for {name} (e.g. 2024-03-15 or 2024-03-15 12:30).
Only the folder changes; the file's EXIF stays as it is.
msg_similar_estimate: Finding similar photos takes about {min} min. Start?
msg_denied: {count} folders could not be read and were skipped
msg_network_slow: Network drive: this can be slow
msg_no_space: Not enough space at the destination: {need} needed, {free} free
msg_blocked_group: Every copy of a duplicate group is set to leave. Keep at least one
msg_moved_list: Files moved before the log failed
msg_thumbs_many: Thumbnails slow things down with more than {count} photos. Turn them on anyway?
msg_thumbs_off: This folder has more than {count} photos. Turn thumbnails off to keep the table fast?
msg_undo_blocked: A later run ({time}, {id}) moved these files again. Undo that one first
msg_undo_trashed_item: In the Recycle Bin (restore it there): {path}
err_log_write: Could not save the log; stopped. Check the list of moved files
err_log_stopped: The log could not be written during the run, so the run stopped. Everything moved so far can be undone
err_log_lost: The log could not be saved. Moved files are listed in the window that opened
err_log_pending: The log could not be saved at the end; it will be completed the next time the program reads it
err_undo_log_write: Cannot write the log {path}: nothing was undone ({error})
err_undo_log_unsaved: Files were put back but the log {path} could not record it ({error})
err_target_exists: a file with that name is already there
err_in_use: the file is open in another program or protected
err_copy_mismatch: the copy did not match the original
err_drive_gone: The folder or drive is no longer there (unplugged?). Stopped; reconnect it and Undo can put back what moved
err_original_taken: another file is now at its original place
err_copy_changed: the file was changed after the run; kept
err_convert: conversion failed ({error}); the HEIC is kept
err_copy_in_place: Copy needs a destination folder other than the source
err_pattern_unknown: Unknown placeholder in the folder pattern
err_pattern_braces: Unbalanced braces in the folder pattern
err_pattern_absolute: The folder pattern must be a relative path
err_bad_regex: Ignored (not a pattern with y, m, d groups): {patterns}
set_include_nodate: Move files without a date to the "No Date" folder
set_jpg_pair_dupe: Treat the JPG of a HEIC/RAW pair as a duplicate (turns HEIC → JPG off)
set_name_patterns_hint: One regular expression per line with named groups y, m, d (and H, M, S for the time). Example: ^MyCam_(?P<y>\d{4})(?P<m>\d{2})(?P<d>\d{2})
cli_desc: Sort photos and videos into date folders, convert HEIC to JPG, find duplicates. Offline, with undo.
cli_help: show this help message and exit
cli_folder: photo folder (no folder: open the window)
cli_dest: destination folder (default: the photo folder itself)
cli_heic_only: only convert HEIC to JPG, organize nothing
cli_dedupe: send identical files to the duplicates folder
cli_similar: also look for similar photos (shown only)
cli_use_mtime: use the modified time for files without a date
cli_include_nodate: move files without a date to the "No Date" folder
